name: garagebench
description: GarageBench MVP for assisted automotive diagnostics

scripts.bootstrap: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.start:all: concurrently "npm --prefix backend run start:dev" "npm --prefix frontend run start"
scripts.test: npm --prefix backend run test && npm --prefix frontend run test
scripts.lint: npm --prefix backend run lint && npm --prefix frontend run lint
